update.title:
/bin/sh -c 'set -eu
manifest=published/manifest.json
artifact=$(sed -n '"'s/.*\"artifact\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"\\(["'^"]*'"\\)\".*/\\1/p' \""'$manifest")
if [ -z "$artifact" ]; then
  echo "No artifact field found in $manifest" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "published/$artifact" ]; then
  echo "Referenced artifact not found: published/$artifact" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cat "published/$artifact"'
